matched_markers: shipping fee calculation method is an enforcement measure
estimated shipping fee calculated when the order is created will not be lower than the estimated shipping fee calculated at shipment
If the seller reduces the package weight or volume, the estimated shipping fee will not be adjusted accordingly
final package weight, dimensions, and billable weight will be based on the measurements taken and reported by the carrier
greater of the product’s volumetric weight (also known as dimensional weight) and actual weight
Actual weight exceeds 50 lb: $10.15 per package
Actual weight exceeds 100 lb: $79.99 per package
logistics service provider will measure the actual weight and dimensions
